summary.text: Becky Cash is a Republican state representative who represents Indiana House District 25, has served since 2022, and is on the ballot for re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Becky Cash was born in Green Bay, Wisconsin, and earned a bachelor's degree from Bowling Green State University.
Her career experience includes owning Indy Natural Health Center and ASD Perspectives.
She has been affiliated with Boone County Republican Women, the Indiana Federation of Republican Women and the nonprofit Stand For Health Freedom.
Cash assumed office on November 9, 2022, succeeding Donald Lehe, and advanced from the Republican primary on May 5, 2026.
In the November 3, 2026 general election she faces Democrat Tiffany Stoner.
For 2025-2026, she was assigned to the Education, Employment, Labor and Pensions, and Veterans Affairs and Public Safety (as vice chair) committees.
